title: 2 Chronicles 34: Josiah the Wise Child Finds the Book of the Law
body:
Read the chapter → [2 Chronicles 34](/bible/2-chronicles/34)

**[2 Chronicles 34:1-3](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v1)**

> <sup>[1](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v1)</sup> Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years.
>
> <sup>[2](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v2)</sup> And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the ways of David his father, and declined neither to the right hand, nor to the left.
>
> <sup>[3](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v3)</sup> For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.

- Josiah is eight years old when he begins to reign and reigns thirty one years in Jerusalem, and he does that which is right in the sight of the Lord and walks in the ways of David his father, declining neither to the right hand nor to the left.
- Comparing the ages shows the point: Manasseh began at twelve, Amon at twenty two, and Josiah at eight, yet the youngest was the wisest. Better is a poor and wise child than an old and foolish king who will no more be admonished.
- In the eighth year of his reign, while yet young, he begins to seek after the God of David, and in the twelfth year he begins to purge Judah and Jerusalem of the high places, groves, and images.

  - **[Ecclesiastes 4:13](/bible/ecclesiastes/4#v13)**
    > <sup>[13](/bible/ecclesiastes/4#v13)</sup> Better is a poor and a wise child than an old and foolish king, who will no more be admonished.

    Better is a poor and wise child than an old and foolish king who will no more be admonished, the very lesson of these young kings.
  - **[Joshua 1:7-8](/bible/joshua/1#v7)**
    > <sup>[7](/bible/joshua/1#v7)</sup> Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.
    >
    > <sup>[8](/bible/joshua/1#v8)</sup> This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.

    Josiah declining neither to the right nor left is the charge to Joshua: observe to do according to all the law, turn not from it, and meditate in it day and night that thy way may be prosperous.

**[2 Chronicles 34:4-7](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v4)**

> <sup>[4](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v4)</sup> And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence; and the images, that were on high above them, he cut down; and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images, he brake in pieces, and made dust of them, and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them.
>
> <sup>[5](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v5)</sup> And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.
>
> <sup>[6](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v6)</sup> And so did he in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, with their mattocks round about.
>
> <sup>[7](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v7)</sup> And when he had broken down the altars and the groves, and had beaten the graven images into powder, and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Israel, he returned to Jerusalem.

- They break down the altars of Baal in his presence, cut down the images and groves, and break the carved and molten images to powder, strowing the dust upon the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.
- He burns the bones of the priests upon their altars and cleanses Judah and Jerusalem, and does the same in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, then returns to Jerusalem.

  - **[Isaiah 66:17](/bible/isaiah/66#v17)**
    > <sup>[17](/bible/isaiah/66#v17)</sup> They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst, eating swine’s flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, saith the Lord.

    Those who sanctify and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree, eating swine's flesh and the abomination, shall be consumed together, the same garden and grove worship Josiah tears down.

**[2 Chronicles 34:8-13](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v8)**

> <sup>[8](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v8)</sup> Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land, and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of the Lord his God.
>
> <sup>[9](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v9)</sup> And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest, they delivered the money that was brought into the house of God, which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and of all the remnant of Israel, and of all Judah and Benjamin; and they returned to Jerusalem.
>
> <sup>[10](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v10)</sup> And they put it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the Lord, and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of the Lord, to repair and amend the house:
>
> <sup>[11](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v11)</sup> Even to the artificers and builders gave they it, to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.
>
> <sup>[12](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v12)</sup> And the men did the work faithfully: and the overseers of them were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set it forward; and other of the Levites, all that could skill of instruments of musick.
>
> <sup>[13](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v13)</sup> Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and were overseers of all that wrought the work in any manner of service: and of the Levites there were scribes, and officers, and porters.

- In the eighteenth year of his reign, when he has purged the land and the house, Josiah sends Shaphan, Maaseiah, and Joah to repair the house of the Lord his God.
- The money the Levites had gathered from Manasseh, Ephraim, and all the remnant of Israel and Judah is put into the hands of the workmen, who buy hewn stone and timber for couplings and to floor the houses the kings of Judah had destroyed.
- The men do the work faithfully under overseers of the Levites, with scribes, officers, and porters, that is security, set over the burdens and the service.

**[2 Chronicles 34:14-18](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v14)**

> <sup>[14](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v14)</sup> And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of the Lord, Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of the Lord given by Moses.
>
> <sup>[15](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v15)</sup> And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the Lord. And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.
>
> <sup>[16](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v16)</sup> And Shaphan carried the book to the king, and brought the king word back again, saying, All that was committed to thy servants, they do it.
>
> <sup>[17](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v17)</sup> And they have gathered together the money that was found in the house of the Lord, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and to the hand of the workmen.
>
> <sup>[18](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v18)</sup> Then Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath given me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

- When they bring out the money, Hilkiah the priest finds a book of the law of the Lord given by Moses, the very Bible, and delivers it to Shaphan the scribe.
- Shaphan carries the book to the king and reads it before him, reporting that all committed to the servants is being done and the money delivered to the workmen.

  - **[Deuteronomy 4:44](/bible/deuteronomy/4#v44)**
    > <sup>[44](/bible/deuteronomy/4#v44)</sup> And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:

    This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel, the same book of the law that was found in the house of the Lord.

**[2 Chronicles 34:19-21](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v19)**

> <sup>[19](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v19)</sup> And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the law, that he rent his clothes.
>
> <sup>[20](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v20)</sup> And the king commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Abdon the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king’s, saying,
>
> <sup>[21](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v21)</sup> Go, enquire of the Lord for me, and for them that are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found: for great is the wrath of the Lord that is poured out upon us, because our fathers have not kept the word of the Lord, to do after all that is written in this book.

- When the king hears the words of the law, he rends his clothes and commands Hilkiah, Ahikam, Abdon, Shaphan, and Asaiah to go inquire of the Lord for him and for the remnant left in Israel and Judah.
- He knows great is the wrath of the Lord poured out because the fathers had not kept the word of the Lord to do all that is written in the book. To inquire of the Lord, one must go to a saint, a chosen prophet who has the word.

  - **[Daniel 9:11-14](/bible/daniel/9#v11)**
    > <sup>[11](/bible/daniel/9#v11)</sup> Yea, all Israel have transgressed thy law, even by departing, that they might not obey thy voice; therefore the curse is poured upon us, and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of God, because we have sinned against him.
    >
    > <sup>[12](/bible/daniel/9#v12)</sup> And he hath confirmed his words, which he spake against us, and against our judges that judged us, by bringing upon us a great evil: for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem.
    >
    > <sup>[13](/bible/daniel/9#v13)</sup> As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil is come upon us: yet made we not our prayer before the Lord our God, that we might turn from our iniquities, and understand thy truth.
    >
    > <sup>[14](/bible/daniel/9#v14)</sup> Therefore hath the Lord watched upon the evil, and brought it upon us: for the Lord our God is righteous in all his works which he doeth: for we obeyed not his voice.

    All Israel had transgressed the law, so the curse and oath written in the law of Moses was poured out upon them, for the Most High is righteous in all his works.
  - **[Job 5:1](/bible/job/5#v1)**
    > <sup>[1](/bible/job/5#v1)</sup> Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; and to which of the saints wilt thou turn?

    Call now, if there be any that will answer thee, and to which of the saints wilt thou turn; to learn the Bible you must go to one of the chosen.

**[2 Chronicles 34:22-28](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v22)**

> <sup>[22](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v22)</sup> And Hilkiah, and they that the king had appointed, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college:) and they spake to her to that effect.
>
> <sup>[23](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v23)</sup> And she answered them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Tell ye the man that sent you to me,
>
> <sup>[24](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v24)</sup> Thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah:
>
> <sup>[25](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v25)</sup> Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, and shall not be quenched.
>
> <sup>[26](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v26)</sup> And as for the king of Judah, who sent you to enquire of the Lord, so shall ye say unto him, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel concerning the words which thou hast heard;
>
> <sup>[27](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v27)</sup> Because thine heart was tender, and thou didst humble thyself before God, when thou heardest his words against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, and humbledst thyself before me, and didst rend thy clothes, and weep before me; I have even heard thee also, saith the Lord.
>
> <sup>[28](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v28)</sup> Behold, I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace, neither shall thine eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants of the same. So they brought the king word again.

- Hilkiah and the men go to Huldah the prophetess, wife of Shallum, who dwells in the college in Jerusalem, and she declares the word of the Lord God of Israel.
- She says the Most High will bring evil and all the curses written in the book upon this place, because they forsook him and burned incense to other gods to provoke him to anger.
- But because Josiah's heart was tender and he humbled himself, wept, and rent his clothes, the Most High will gather him to his fathers in peace so his eyes will not see the evil to come.

  - **[Ecclesiasticus 3:17-20](/bible/sirach/3#v17)**
    > <sup>[17](/bible/sirach/3#v17)</sup> My son, go on with thy business in meekness; so shalt thou be beloved of him that is approved.
    >
    > <sup>[18](/bible/sirach/3#v18)</sup> The greater thou art, the more humble thyself, and thou shalt find favour before the Lord.
    >
    > <sup>[19](/bible/sirach/3#v19)</sup> Many are in high place, and of renown: but mysteries are revealed unto the meek.
    >
    > <sup>[20](/bible/sirach/3#v20)</sup> For the power of the Lord is great, and he is honoured of the lowly.

    Humble yourself before the Most High and you find favour, and the mysteries are revealed to the meek and lowly, as they were to tender hearted Josiah.
  - **[Isaiah 57:1](/bible/isaiah/57#v1)**
    > <sup>[1](/bible/isaiah/57#v1)</sup> The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth it to heart: and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come.

    The righteous perisheth and no man layeth it to heart, and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come, which is why Josiah is gathered in peace.

**[2 Chronicles 34:29-33](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v29)**

> <sup>[29](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v29)</sup> Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
>
> <sup>[30](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v30)</sup> And the king went up into the house of the Lord, and all the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people, great and small: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the Lord.
>
> <sup>[31](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v31)</sup> And the king stood in his place, and made a covenant before the Lord, to walk after the Lord, and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book.
>
> <sup>[32](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v32)</sup> And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand to it. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.
>
> <sup>[33](/bible/2-chronicles/34#v33)</sup> And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of Israel, and made all that were present in Israel to serve, even to serve the Lord their God. And all his days they departed not from following the Lord, the God of their fathers.

- Josiah gathers all the elders, priests, Levites, and all the people great and small, and reads in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant found in the house of the Lord.
- He stands in his place and makes a covenant before the Lord to walk after him and keep his commandments, testimonies, and statutes with all his heart and soul, and causes all present to stand to it.
- Josiah takes away all the abominations out of all the countries belonging to the children of Israel and makes all present serve the Lord their God, and they depart not from following him all his days. All wisdom is the performance of the law.
